scientific_integrity: The all-radius statement is proved analytically from the exact Gumbel CDF, an elementary lower bound, and the normal Mills bound. A standalone numerical checker is used only for regression checks and a non-theorem crossover locator. The closest primary source was inspected at its Gumbel theorem; a related classical-source comparison is retained as an originality risk because only a secondary excerpt was accessible.
scientific_limitations: The theorem proves a permanent reversal for every standardized radius at least three and existence of a crossover between one and three. It does not prove uniqueness or the sharp crossover radius, and it is specific to the Gumbel location-scale family.
title: A three-sigma reversal in the Gumbel–Gaussian variation comparison
